corpus_rules.sampling_and_stopping_rule: Traverse each pinned repository history in deterministic topological reverse-chronological order; evaluate and log every candidate until each per-system quota is met or its history is exhausted. Verify git cat-file -e, git rev-parse <fix_sha>^1, non-comment code diff and parseable pre-fix/fix bundles in gen/M4/I48/bundles/<defect_id>/. Never replace a failed candidate silently; record disqualification and shortfall.
corpus_rules.pair_distinctness: All entries have distinct (repo_url, fix_sha) pairs and distinct defect_id values.

deterministic_selection.head_policy: Record the full pinned head SHA or release ref and resolved SHA for each repository in corpus_verification.json before traversal; alternatively record the full deterministic commit list and audit it against the clone's git log.
deterministic_selection.traversal: For each system in candidate_systems order, git log --topo-order --date-order from the pinned head (reverse chronological); evaluate matching commits in that order through the quota-reaching commit, or to history exhaustion. Record every evaluated commit, including rejects. Sort accepted manifest entries by (system, defect_id).
deterministic_selection.pre_fix_sha: Exactly git rev-parse <fix_sha>^1, not an arbitrary ancestor; reject root commits.
deterministic_selection.source_filter: At least one non-test .go or .sol file changed; exclude *_test.go, *Test.sol, *.t.sol, and paths or basenames containing mock (case-insensitive).
deterministic_selection.code_diff: git diff pre_fix_sha fix_sha -- source_files must contain a non-comment, non-whitespace added or removed source line; diff headers do not count.
deterministic_selection.bundle: One primary file or a bounded 1-3 source-file bundle, same repository-relative paths at both revisions. Verify each file byte-for-byte against git show; Go with gofmt -e and Solidity with solc-0.8.24 --stop-after parsing or verified AST tokenization and balanced declarations.
deterministic_selection.distinctness: Reject repeated defect site and repeated (repo_url, fix_sha); preserve source_files and primary_file.
deterministic_selection.evaluated_candidates: Log every evaluated candidate through the stopping point in traversal order with system, fix_sha, pre_fix_sha, accepted boolean; rejects have exactly one explicit disqualification_reason from disqualification_reasons.
deterministic_selection.shortfall: If a system quota is unmet, log pinned head, number traversed, accepted count, and verified repository exhaustion. A shortfall cannot waive target_count while 20 or more qualifying commits exist in the pinned histories.

rubric.PAR: Parallel representations or codec round trips disagree.
rubric.SORT: A refined domain, width, index, tag or boundary is violated.
rubric.UND: Rollback or undo fails to restore all dependent state.
rubric.FACT: A cross-step or cross-component factor/commitment invariant fails.
rubric.DISCH: An obligation, authorization or guard is not discharged.
rubric.OUT_OF_SCOPE: No minimal HOLON rule above describes the defect.

blind_labeling_rules.neutral_packet_rubric: Assess which smallest observable obligation fails, using only the pre-fix source and actual fix diff. Do not infer a preferred outcome from provenance.
blind_labeling_rules.packet_manifest_sha256: SHA256 of concatenated lexicographically sorted per-packet SHA256 hex digests (UTF-8, no separators).
blind_labeling_rules.session_contract: Two fresh independent read-only sessions classify every packet without seeing each other's labels, author predictions or outcomes. Preserve original raw outputs unmodified.
blind_labeling_rules.adjudication_rule: Record per-defect rater A and B labels, confidence, agreement status, primary_rule, final_label (equal to primary_rule) and adjudication_rationale. On disagreement with low confidence set primary_rule UNCERTAIN; if both confidences are high/medium, choose one rater's primary rule or cite a named labeling_rubric.tie_break_clauses key. Compute exact raw agreement count / N and Cohen's kappa from original categorical outputs, including OUT_OF_SCOPE; when chance agreement is 1, kappa is 1 only for perfect agreement.

tie_break_clauses.minimal_rule: Choose the minimal rule that directly captures the failing obligation.
tie_break_clauses.parallel_over_domain: Prefer PAR only when two representations disagree on the same admitted input; otherwise choose the domain rule.
tie_break_clauses.out_of_scope: Choose OUT_OF_SCOPE only when no named rule captures the observed defect.

renaming_rules.algorithm: Deterministic injective scope/binding-aware identifier renaming across each source bundle, consistently rewriting bound uses; do not use raw-text regex substitution.
renaming_rules.coverage: Every corpus bundle and synthetic Go/Solidity shadowing, selector, import, comment and string-literal edge cases; 100 percent must pass.

control_rules.true_requirement: Each known_true control has an explicit algebraic or structural invariant justification and a Bend/Python verification artifact in gen/M4/I48/controls/ recorded in results/M4/I48/controls_report.json.
control_rules.false_requirement: Each known_false control has a concrete witness with witness_scale > standard_budget, passes for all inputs <= standard_budget, and violates the property at witness_scale; record checked evidence.
control_rules.isolation: All .py and .bend files under holon/ outside holon/eval/ and gen/M0 through gen/M3 must not reference spec/eval, results/M4, holon.eval, C01_known_true, or C07_known_false.
control_rules.model_sides_api: holon.eval.controls.evaluate_sides(control_id, witness) computes (lhs, rhs) on the generated model, independently of the reported verdict.
control_rules.bend_check: Every true proof and false concrete counter-law must contain the expected named law and be accepted by bend with ALL PROOFS CHECK; do not treat vacuous checker output as evidence.
